replies.author: Lieutenantpants
replies.body: Seconded. I think the main cause of confusion is (sadly) people who are a little over-eager, see a swear word and immediately assume that it's being used in a derogatory context. (Pretty much all juniors are this way, it happens, it's exciting). Swearing on its own shouldn't be a big deal. Swearing at someone is, akin to the way that saying "hacks" is fine but "Lieutenantpants hacker" is not.

basically i agree w/ nolan
